title: What to send with a transfer inquiry
excerpt: A short message is enough to start. These are the details that let the company answer with availability.
body: This is a demonstration article. Replace it with the company's own writing before launch.
Send the pickup point, the destination, the date and time, the number of passengers, and how much luggage you have. For an airport collection, a flight number helps the company watch for a delay.
The website does not reserve a vehicle or confirm a price. The reply on WhatsApp is where availability and the fare are agreed.

title: Asking for an airport collection
excerpt: Name the airport, the terminal if you know it, and the flight. The company confirms the pickup after it reads the message.
body: This is a demonstration article. Replace it with the company's own writing before launch.
An airport collection is a request, not a booking made on this page. Include the airport, whether you are arriving or departing, and the time you expect to be ready.
If the flight changes, send the new number in the same conversation so the company can tell you whether the pickup can move with it.
imageAlt: Placeholder photograph of a black luxury sedan on a tree-lined road at dusk. This is not a confirmed company vehicle.

title: Matching luggage to the vehicle
excerpt: Passenger count is only half of the request. Luggage decides whether a sedan, an SUV, or a van is the right fit.
body: This is a demonstration article. Replace it with the company's own writing before launch.
Tell the company how many suitcases and cabin bags are travelling, not only how many people. A sedan that seats the party can still be the wrong vehicle when the luggage does not fit.
The capacities shown with each vehicle are placeholders for this preview. The company confirms the vehicle that can take the trip.
imageAlt: Placeholder photograph of a black luxury SUV parked beside a modern building. This is not a confirmed company vehicle.

title: Requesting a journey between cities
excerpt: Intercity travel can be requested in the same way as a city transfer. Share both places and the timing.
body: This is a demonstration article. Replace it with the company's own writing before launch.
Name the city or place you leave from and the city or place you are going to. Add the date, the time you want to depart, and whether you need a stop on the way.
Nothing on this website is a timetable or a fare. The company replies with whether it can take the journey and what it will cost.
